take_homes: Ask the teammate how they do the job today before I decide what to share.
The people plan matters as much as the technical one, and an empty owner slot is the thing to chase.
Pick the sharing shape (shared context, a skill, a pushed output, or a pull interface) because it moves their outcome, not because the platform exists.

monday.move: Ask the analyst who builds the pilot-cohort numbers how she assembles the brief today, and show her nothing. Then decide whether the shared-context option fits, since my blocker is that every teammate keeps their own copy of the context files.
monday.who: The analyst on my team who feeds the pricing working group. I need to pick her from the fourteen.
monday.when: Monday, before the pricing working group.
monday.stop_condition: If she says she is happy with her current route or gets the numbers elsewhere, I drop this candidate and don't pitch it.
monday.blocker: My team has no shared place for the context files, and nobody owns it yet.

misconception.why: The module spends its time on who owns, governs and operates the thing, and none of it on better prompts. I still think prompts matter for output quality, but they aren't what gets a team of fourteen working on the pricing move.
